parameters.name: ConfigType
parameters.description:
Configuration type. You can use this parameter to query global or rule configurations. Valid values:

- global: queries global configurations.
- rule: queries rule configurations.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Number of entries per page. Maximum value: 500. Default value: 500.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: Site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) API.

parameters.name: SiteVersion
parameters.description: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with configuration version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: 0.
